verdict_reason: The code-keyed CPH check is correct, but it keeps a second copy of the cph obligation's applicability rule beside the obligation itself.

todos.issue: hasNonExemptCode/isCphApplicable (lines 28-33) restate the CPH applicability rule that the cph obligation already owns in obligations/sections/commodities/aggregates.js (applyTo: anyNotInUnionOf(commodityCode, cphExemptCommodityCodes, ...)). The rewrite keeps two homes for one rule, and they already differ in detail: Boolean(line?.commodityCode) here vs isBlankValue in the gate. The addresses hub decides whether to show the CPH row from this copy, while state.get already returns the evaluated scope (hub/controller.js reads scope.inScope).
